decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY covering suitable compatible LEDs, their flash-and-pizazz effect, and the SOCIAL_MEDIA context.
The client explicitly says the proposed button change is not understood and makes no new decision about control styling or measurement details.
The source establishes a broad visual goal for the base but does not change any logo wording, placard placement, typography, or other branding attribute.
The source does not change the established beige and green colors or any color-placement rule.
The visual emphasis on the base and social-media appearance does not alter the spout's geometry, orientation, construction, or beverage-quality constraints.
Decorative LEDs and the requested visual character do not change bowl removal, swapping, clearance, or cleaning behavior.
The source contains no decision changing bowl capacity, depth, size, or form.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY requiring selection of suitable compatible LEDs and recording them as an addition to the approved component set.
The source discusses decorative appearance and does not modify splash targets, guards, or high-speed mitigation measures.

Although the visible base is the subject of the visual-design decision, the source does not change the platform's structural configuration, height, cup clearance, or mixer fit; its appearance is already represented by the source visual-identity Requirement.
The decorative and social-media appearance decision does not change fluid-path cleaning, sanitation, or liquid-trap requirements.
Selecting suitable LEDs is compatible with the existing practical sourcing policy and does not establish a new exception or otherwise change the V1 approach.
